claim: Our queen's deaths by wall or own body happen on narrow tiles; per queen turn that starts on a narrow tile in raw rounds 101-200 she dies that way about three times as often as their queens; and on Maze and weakhold she starts a turn on a narrow tile two to four times as often as their queens. It is not a property of corridor-heavy layouts.
how_to_count: Games: our_code main or v31, layouts with queen_spawn_dead_end false (join on map_key). Queen = lowest initial dragon id of each side. At every turnStart of a living queen take her head tile on the rebuilt board. Open sides = number of the four edges of that tile that are not kelp (a portal edge counts as open; dragons are ignored; wrap applies). Narrow tile = two or fewer open sides; dead-end tile = one. Window by the raw round of the turn: 0-100, 101-200, 201-300, 301 on. (1) Share of queen turns on a narrow tile, per side, r0-200, for main Maze #1, main weakhold #1, v31 Maze #1, v31 weakhold #1; the same pooled over Tower Defense #1, Trauma #1 and Devil #1 (both codes); and per layout. (2) For every queen death with engine reason 0 (wall) or 1 (own body) whose raw round is 101-200: open sides of her head tile at the start of her last turn. Count deaths that start on a narrow tile and divide by that side's queen turns on narrow tiles in r101-200 (per 1,000), main and v31 apart and pooled; also the two halves of main (before and from 2026-10-06T14:48:15Z). (3) Seen after my count, please recount and judge: among narrow-tile turn starts in r101-200, those with a body tile of another dragon of her own team on a neighbour tile (the tile across each open side; follow portals), per side; and the deaths in (2) split into own dragon beside her, dead-end tile, other. Please also check whether the per-turn gap survives leaving out Portals #1 and whether any one opponent carries it.

claim: Over turns spent as the only living queen, a short enemy head (length 4 or less) is within 6 path steps of our queen two and a half to four times as often as a short head of ours is within 6 path steps of theirs, and our lone queen has fewer heads of her own team within 5 tiles.
how_to_count: Games: our_code main or v31, layouts with queen_spawn_dead_end false. Queen = lowest initial dragon id of each side. A queen turn is a lone turn when the other side's queen died in an earlier event of the game (any earlier round or earlier in the same round). At the turnStart of each lone turn: (1) breadth-first search from her head over open edges and portal edges (kelp blocks, dragons ignored, wrap applies) to depth 6; flag the turn if any living enemy dragon of body length 4 or less has its head on a reached tile (distance 0 to 6). (2) count living dragons of her own team other than herself whose head is within 5 tiles of her head by wrapped Manhattan distance (no kelp, no portals). Report per side: lone turns, flagged turns, sum and mean of (2), turns with (2) equal to 0. Sets: full games (last_round 499), all endings, and level games (curves 100 total: min at least 0.8 of max), main and v31 apart; main by opponent rating band; by 50-round bins since the other queen died. Base rate: the same flag over queen turns with both queens alive, by window r0-100, r101-200, r201-300, r301 on. Please judge whether the gap is more than the two sides simply having different numbers of short dragons alive at those turns, and whether one opponent or layout carries it.
